creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`pane send --confirm` passed for text that then never reached a busy Claude Code pane. This is the opposite failure from card `pane-send-confirm` (GitHub issue #2 part 10), where confirm says a send failed that worked.

2026-10-11, a local 0.15.0 build, from tooling feedback: a Claude Code worker mid-turn in bypass-permissions mode. `pane send --pane P "<about 450 chars>" --confirm && pane send --pane P " " --enter` both exited 0. Four seconds later the prompt was empty and the text appeared nowhere in 200 rows of scrollback. Retyping it with `--confirm` showed it in the prompt, and a separate `" " --enter` then submitted it as a queued message.

Not established: whether the text was lost, or taken into the running turn without being drawn. The worker's session JSONL would settle it, so read that first if it can be reproduced. `confirm` in `crates/muster-core/src/pane_text.rs` returns on the first read that shows the text and, by design, checks arrival rather than submission. The open questions are whether a busy TUI can redraw matched text away, and whether the second call's Return removed it.
title: pane send --confirm passed, but the text never reached a busy Claude pane
